title: The Morning Digest: October 30, 2026
dek: Thursday's settles were Brent Dec26 $114.88 (down $0.44) and WTI Dec26 $102.00 (down $0.78). Asia reversed the decline overnight, Brent $116.08 and WTI $103.37 at 0323 GMT (Reuters, Oct 30), after a small boat attached explosive devices to an outbound tanker's hull in the Strait of Hormuz, a second tanker took a projectile, and the Houthis claimed a six target wave against Saudi Arabia including a second strike claim on Ras Tanura, still unconfirmed on day three. The Energy Department announced awards of more than 40 million barrels of reserve crude on Oct 29, completing its 172 million barrel release commitment. December WCS at -$30.50 (ICE TMW settle, Oct 29) on 1 lot, after Wednesday's -$31.10 traded 200 lots. The diesel crack fell to $90.42. Imperial Oil reports today.

sources.publisher: Reuters, Oct 29 to 30, 2026 (Thursday settles: Brent Dec26 $114.88, down $0.44; WTI Dec26 $102.00, down $0.78; Asia prints at 0323 GMT Oct 30: Brent Dec $116.08, up $1.20, Brent Jan $112.19, up $1.39, WTI $103.37, up $1.37; Tasnim via Reuters Oct 30: Iran received the US letter and has not responded; the CENTCOM commander briefed the President on Iran options on Oct 29, via the Wall Street Journal; ExxonMobil and Chevron executives cancelled ADIPEC travel, Oct 29 to 30; Brent December expires Oct 30; October is a fourth straight monthly gain)
